استنجيا (form X)
# اِسْتَنْجَيَا (istanjayā) /is.tan.d͡ʒa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَنْجَى (istanjā)
# اُسْتُنْجِيَا (ustunjiyā) /us.tun.d͡ʒi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَنْجَى (istanjā)
# اِسْتَنْجِيَا (istanjiyā) /is.tan.d͡ʒi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَنْجَى (istanjā)
